title: Power Concerns in America's Largest Electricity Market
description: Data centers in the US may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts, according to TechCrunch, as America's largest electricity market grapples with resource adequacy and affordability.

sections.heading: Power Cuts for Data Centers
paragraphs: Data centers in the US may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on the largest US grid, TechCrunch reports.

sections.heading: Resource Adequacy and Affordability
paragraphs: The PJM Board has directed action on resource adequacy, affordability, and large loads, as reported by PJM Inside Lines.

sections.heading: Market Reforms
paragraphs: Heatmap News discusses the lurch towards reform in America's largest electricity market, indicating significant changes may be on the horizon.
